question: Which Indian tabla virtuoso and musician won the 'Best Contemporary World Music Album' Grammy award for 'Global Drum Project'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Zakir Hussain.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain**

 
 
• ​The **Indian tabla virtuoso and musician who won the 'Best Contemporary World Music Album' Grammy award for 'Global Drum Project'** was **Ustad Zakir Hussain.**
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain, an Indian tabla musician, composer, percussionist, music producer, and film actor, was born on **March 9, 1951.**
 
• The Indian government honoured him with the **Padma Shri in 1988, the Padma Bhushan in 2002, and the Padma Vibhushan in 2023.**
 
• Also, he received the **Ratna Sadsya in 2018**, the Fellowship of the **Sangeet Natak Akademi, and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Prize** from the Government of India in 1990. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Drum Project**

 
 
• **Mickey Hart, Zakir Hussain, Sikiru Adepoju, and Giovanni Hidalgo** collaborated on the album titled **World Drum Project.**
 
• The album includes music made with a variety of **drums and other instruments,** vocals from people chanting and singing, and electronic samples.
 
• It combines traditional music with contemporary electronic music, which was informed by **Mickey Hart's musicological research** on drumming from throughout the world.
 
• The **2009 Grammy Award for Best Contemporary World Music Album** went to Global Drum Project.
